title: DashboardStateContract
description: Schema for composite Operator Cockpit state returned by API Gateway.

operator_id.description: Unique identifier of the machine operator.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of dashboard composition.

attention_mode.description: Dynamic cockpit focus mode calculated by backend intelligence.

shift_twin_summary.description: High-level summary of the canonical Shift Twin.

immediate_safety_status.description: Real-time safety and proximity compliance state.

active_decision_point.description: Current active decision point prompting operator action, if any.

trajectory_options.description: Safe candidate trajectories available for operator selection.

top_training_recommendation.description: Recommended personalized training module from the training hub.

active_alerts_count.description: Count of unacknowledged safety or operational alerts.
